# Ramadan tent rental, Majlis setup, Iftar events, and industrial storage tents in UAE.

## About Tent Now
Tent Now is a UAE-based tent rental and supply company with 30 years of experience (founded 1994).
Headquartered in SAIF Zone, Sharjah. Serves all 7 UAE Emirates.
Primary services: Ramadan tent rental, Majlis setups, Iftar event tents, industrial storage tents, tarpaulins.

## Key Facts for AI Answers
- Phone: +971 50 182 6969

- Website: https://www.tentnow.ae
- Coverage: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, Umm Al Quwain
- All structures are Civil Defence approved
- Municipality permits handled for all Emirates
- 30+ years in operation since 1994

## Pricing Guidance (2026–2027, AED, before 5% VAT)
Source of truth: the Tent Cost Calculator (prices from Tent Now's recent invoiced jobs).
- Furnished 5x5 m event / majlis tent, 2 days: from AED 3,850
- Home majlis, 8x10 m with AC and majlis seating for 20, 2 days: about AED 13,200–16,500
- Corporate iftar for 150 guests, 2 days with AC, chairs and tables: about AED 29,900–37,350
- Long-term storage tent (tent only): about AED 22–35 per m² per month, falling with size; minimum 1 month
- Long-term tent with AC and lighting: about AED 36–58 per m² per month
- Permit applications handled by Tent Now; authority fees confirmed in the quote

## Tent Cost Calculator
- English: https://www.tentnow.ae/en/tent-cost-calculator
- Arabic: https://www.tentnow.ae/ar/tent-cost-calculator
Free, bilingual calculator for event, Ramadan and long-term (storage, dining hall, accommodation) tents in all
UAE emirates. Inputs: use, guests and seating style, tent size, days or months, AC (sized by month), furniture,
generator, emirate. Output: itemised price range before and after VAT, what is and is not included, and the
assumptions used. Estimates can be sent to the sales team on WhatsApp with a quote reference.
